1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Clearly list the appliance identifier, such as model, serial number, and location.
3. Detail the date and time of the testing.
4. Note the test equipment used, including the make, model, and calibration status.
5. Mention the name and professional qualifications of the tester.
6. Document the safety check environment and conditions, such as temperature and humidity if relevant.
7. List all checks conducted.
8. Describe any issues identified, including specific faults or malfunctions, such as a failed earth continuity test or insulation resistance test, referencing the relevant test sections and standards.
9. Explain the results in terms of pass/fail and safe/unsafe for use.
10. Describe any specific hazards identified, outlining the potential risks to users or the workplace.
11. Note the non-conformities against relevant safety standards or regulations.
